risk_note: CT-13m (link_log_evidence; 编排 D10-1624 / D10-1625 / D10-1648 / D10-1649; BR-ATTR-14 default 'claim-referenced records are copied to link_log_evidence before partition deletion', BR-ID-30 ② 'link_log_evidence 工单关闭后 180 天'). Migration 0144_link-log-evidence.sql: app.link_log_evidence (all link_logs columns + copied_at, not partitioned, pk (id); couli_app / couli_readonly / couli_maint SELECT only, writes only through SECURITY DEFINER functions); app.copy_referenced_link_logs(p_partition, p_before, p_copied_at) copies rows referenced by any claim_items.evidence_link_log_ids (ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; EXECUTE couli_maint only); app.drop_expired_day_partitions is CREATE OR REPLACE word for word 0012 plus one PERFORM of the copy after the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and before each DROP, so a copy failure rolls back and drops nothing; app.purge_expired_link_log_evidence(p_now) deletes evidence whose referencing items are all decided with the latest decided_at < +08:00 day 00:00 − 180 days, and evidence no claim_item references (D10-1625 补一); 180 only inside the function. Maintenance section O calls the purge once per +08:00 day from 04:00 after the link_logs day-partition drop, failure logged, counted, rethrown at the end, day marked only on success. linking's createLinkLogMomentReader falls back to link_log_evidence for ids not in link_logs. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts: one line, link_log_evidence added to the funds / attribution set (D10-1648, #16). db/schema.sql and db.gen.ts from the local snapshot (D10-1553). Only claim_items references link_logs today; decided_at is written by the review path only and there is no whole-claim cancel path on main yet. Rule tests (independent Claude, 3 attempts): 13 cases in test/spec/linking/link-log-evidence/** (attempt 2 added the maintenance-schedule test for spec-test r1's S1, attempt 3 removed two SCHEDULE rounds that contradicted the file's own 04:00 gate). Red with the current trusted root: red/3 PASS (13 in 6 files). Test machine, rebased on main c6962af32 (couli-runs/CT-13m/run4, head 2cd677dc7, real runs, no cache, D10-1772): verify:fast green; test/spec/linking/link-log-evidence + test/spec/db + test/spec/platform 491 files 4547/4547 green (frozen partition tests included). Earlier run3 on the old base was green as well.
